relationship_to_v1: A new prospective protocol for future powered Studies; V1 remains immutable audit history and is neither rewritten nor treated as an executed frame.

maintenance_primary.population: Pre-treatment public GitHub repositories with an existing complete Skill package and immutable public facts supporting exactly one maintenance, audit, preservation, repair, or honest-rejection task.

creation_secondary.population: Pre-treatment public GitHub repositories with a public issue, pull request, commit, or repository specification requesting one new Skill and enough immutable facts to verify the authored package without inventing requirements.

post_treatment_deployment_sensitivity.population: Current query-discoverable public Skill packages first published after the treatment became public.
post_treatment_deployment_sensitivity.limitation: The candidate revision may have influenced these packages or their conventions, so this cohort measures current deployment behavior rather than an uncontaminated pre-treatment population effect.

include: Repository metadata proves public, non-archived, non-fork status at the frozen source identity.
An OSI-identifiable repository license and its exact blob are captured at the source commit.
The maintenance cohort has one exact-case SKILL.md with string name and description fields; a declared compatibility field may be absent or invalid when that condition defines the task.
Every task requirement is supported by typed facts extracted from immutable same-repository Skill, issue, pull-request, commit, or repository-specification sources.
The selected package can be archived without submodules, unsafe links, generated dependency trees, credentials, private labels, mutable resolution, or network-dependent trial setup.
Package source, public basis records, and task facts predate the applicable cohort cutoff.
exclude: The anthropics/skills treatment repository, Fugue repositories, benchmark fixtures, or packages authored for this campaign.
Forks, mirrors, registry snapshots, generated catalog copies, or packages assigned to an already selected source-lineage cluster.
A public task would require invented platform constraints, expected edits, names, compatibility claims, or reference output.
The required task needs credentials, private data, live services, installation, downloading, building, or network access during an Agent trial.
The only apparent YAML fact is a regex match in prose, an example, or a fenced block rather than parsed top-level frontmatter.
Eligibility, stratum, lineage, or reviewer disagreement remains unresolved at frame freeze.
eligibility.terminal_ledger: Every discovered repository and candidate package receives one immutable included or excluded decision with reason codes; silent drops are forbidden.

frontmatter.parser: Pinned YAML safe loader over only the first complete top-level frontmatter document in the immutable SKILL.md blob.

typed_public_facts.privacy: Typed public facts contain source-derived assertions and digests only. Expected outputs, gold edits, private reviewer notes, and treatment responses remain absent.

review_and_adjudication.reviewer_independence: Two different human reviewers independently assess source eligibility, typed facts, proposed stratum, task support, and lineage before seeing any baseline or candidate output.
blinding: No seeded selection rank until eligibility and lineage are frozen
review_and_adjudication.adjudication: Any disagreement on inclusion, exclusion, source fact, stratum, or lineage is resolved by a third human adjudicator with a signed reason; unresolved records are excluded before selection.
review_and_adjudication.agreement_reporting: Report raw agreement and chance-corrected agreement separately for eligibility and stratum assignment before unsealing development tasks.

lineage_and_independence.repository_rule: At most one primary holdout Skill is selected from a canonical GitHub repository, even when that repository contains multiple eligible packages.
lineage_and_independence.cross_repository_lineage_rule: Repositories connected by fork/source/template identity or copied and near-copied Skill content share one lineage cluster and contribute at most one primary holdout unit.
signals: GitHub repository node_id, fork parent, source repository, and template_repository identities
exact SKILL.md Git blob SHA and content SHA-256
explicit upstream, origin, copied-from, or generated-from URLs
five-token-shingle MinHash similarity over normalized SKILL.md content

near_copy_rule.normalization: Unicode NFC, LF newlines, trailing-space removal, and collapse of runs of horizontal whitespace outside fenced code; retain words, headings, and code content.
near_copy_rule.decision: A threshold hit is reviewer-confirmed as same-lineage or documented as an adjudicated false positive before frame freeze.

lineage_and_independence.owner_sensitivity: Report a secondary owner-clustered sensitivity analysis; attempts and multiple packages from one repository never increase the primary independent sample size.
lineage_and_independence.multiple_packages_policy: Additional eligible packages from a selected repository may be used only in development or an explicitly secondary repository-clustered sensitivity analysis.

sampling_and_randomness.population_freeze: Freeze query receipts, terminal eligibility ledger, typed public facts, lineage assignments, repository exclusions, stratum counts, and their canonical bundle digest before choosing a beacon round.

external_randomness.population_bundle_digest: SHA256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON containing the exact query-plan digest, final collector-receipt digest, candidate JSONL digest, population JSONL digest, provenance JSONL digest, terminal eligibility-ledger digest, reviewer-registry digest, authenticated review-verification digest, authenticated sampling-design-amendment digest, and authenticated prospective-power-receipt digest; keys are sorted, separators are comma/colon, ASCII escaping is disabled, and no trailing newline is included.
external_randomness.seed_formula: SHA256(UTF8(lowercase_population_bundle_sha256 + newline + lowercase_drand_chain_hash + newline + decimal_round + newline + lowercase_randomness_hex)); no trailing newline is included.

sampling_and_randomness.selection_algorithm: Within each cohort and declared stratum, sort lineage-eligible repository/package records by SHA256(UTF8(lowercase_selection_seed_hex + newline + source_lineage_cluster_id + newline + repository_node_id + newline + skill_path + newline + lowercase_public_basis_bundle_sha256)); no trailing newline is included and the stable record ID is the deterministic collision tie-break.
sampling_and_randomness.package_within_repository: When a repository has multiple eligible packages, retain only the first package under the externally seeded package ordering before repository-level selection.
sampling_and_randomness.partition_order: Freeze all partitions together; allocate sealed primary holdouts first, then development, then safety controls from the remaining ordered records without replacement.
sampling_and_randomness.replacement: A post-selection preparation failure is recorded at its original rank and replaced only by the next precomputed eligible record in the same cohort and stratum. No investigator choice is allowed.
sampling_and_randomness.quota_rule: Holdout sizes and any rare-stratum oversampling are frozen only after a population-based prospective simulation, before treatment output, under a separately digested sampling-design amendment.
sampling_and_randomness.insufficient_stratum_rule: Use a finite census with an explicit descriptive claim, redefine the estimand under a new preregistration, or block. Never synthesize packages or count attempts as independent sources.

inclusion_weights_and_analysis.primary_population_estimator: Stratified Hajek paired mean with a Horvitz-Thompson total as a sensitivity analysis.
inclusion_weights_and_analysis.inclusion_probability: For simple seeded sampling without replacement inside stratum h, pi_i = n_h / N_h; any additional discovery or feasibility stage must contribute its documented probability rather than being ignored.
inclusion_weights_and_analysis.weighting_rule: Primary community estimates use frozen inclusion weights. An unweighted equal-stratum mean is reported only as a balanced-benchmark secondary estimand.
inclusion_weights_and_analysis.repeated_attempts: Attempts estimate within-task repeatability and are nested inside task, repository, owner, and lineage; they never increase independent N.
inclusion_weights_and_analysis.variance: Use a design-consistent stratified variance with finite-population correction and a preregistered lineage/owner-clustered sensitivity analysis.
inclusion_weights_and_analysis.safety_and_judge: Critical deterministic safety gates, qualitative judge labels, mechanism evidence, and efficiency remain separate from the weighted primary outcome.
inclusion_weights_and_analysis.power_gate: Recompute prospective power from frozen stratum sizes, expected discordance assumptions, inclusion weights, and lineage design effect before generating a holdout preview.

task_authoring_and_sealing.public_brief: Treatment-blind, grounded only in the selected immutable package and typed public facts, and requests exactly one bounded authoring, maintenance, audit, preservation, repair, or rejection outcome.
task_authoring_and_sealing.private_label: Mode-0600 host-only artifact containing expected files, source-derived requirements, preservation hashes, validity boundaries, and scoring inputs; only its digest enters preparation and approval.
task_authoring_and_sealing.authoring_review: A reviewer who did not write the task confirms that the brief neither exposes the expected treatment result nor requires facts absent from PublicSkillFactsV2.
task_authoring_and_sealing.holdout_access: Holdout packages, briefs, and private labels are encrypted or access-controlled for the execution role until a separate exact holdout preview is approved; every access is audited.
task_authoring_and_sealing.trial_boundary: Agent trials receive one digest-verified read-only source archive and public brief. They may not clone, fetch, install, download, build, access the Docker socket, inspect another partition, or resolve mutable references.

raw_public_data_privacy.storage: Acquisition directories are mode 0700 and raw response, candidate, and receipt files are mode 0600; symbolic-link targets are rejected.
raw_public_data_privacy.scan_boundary: A pinned credential-pattern scanner records only pattern IDs, affected immutable record IDs, response digests, and JSON paths. Matched values are never copied into a receipt, review ledger, task, trace, or report.
raw_public_data_privacy.affected_record_policy: A token-shaped or private-value finding blocks the record from task authoring and export until a separately digested reviewer decision excludes it or a sanitized derivative is created without modifying the immutable raw source.

readiness.fail_closed: No source lock, task archive, comparison spec, preview, approval, model call, or paid cell may be created from this protocol alone. A complete validated V2 frame and separate exact Study artifacts are required.
